hooks.command: input=$(cat); if echo "$input" | grep -q '"git commit'; then node -e "const fs=require('fs');try{JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('public/content.json','utf8'));process.exit(0)}catch(e){console.log(JSON.stringify({decision:'block',reason:'public/content.json invalid JSON: '+e.message}));}" 2>/dev/null; fi
